text:
priya_support: FYI customer hitting 400 on POST /v1/rerank. They sent a wrapped payload from a mobile proxy. Error: "missing required key: items". Attaching example they sent.

priya_support: ```json
{
  "request_id": "abc-123",
  "payload": {
    "items": "[{\"id\":\"a\",\"text\":\"foo\"}]"
  }
}
```

carlos_dev: thanks — can you paste the raw curl? customers often JSON-encode the array into a string which trips our parser.

priya_support: they gave this curl: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \n -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" \n -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n -d '{"request_id":"abc-123","payload":{"items":"[{\"id\":\"a\",\"text\":\"foo\"}]"}}'
```

john_oncall: repro'd locally, server returns 400 with body: `{"error":"invalid_request: items must be an array of objects"}`. Looks like our validation bails on stringified arrays before decoding.

ingrid_sre: quick note: this also happens when items is present but an empty string or empty array string "[]". We should treat stringified arrays as a client bug and return a clearer hint.

carlos_dev: Agreed. Two action items: 1) Support reply with exact repro and suggested fix (un-stringify the items field or send items directly as an array). 2) Create engineering bug to improve error message and add detection for stringified arrays. I'll open ENG ticket.

priya_support: Suggested support reply drafted: "Hi — thanks for the report. Your request has `items` encoded as a JSON string. The rerank API expects `items` to be an array of objects. Please send `items` as an array (e.g. "items": [{"id":"a","text":"foo"}]) not as a string. If you're using our SDK, upgrade to latest or send the raw object.

If you can't change the client, we can add a short-term proxy rule to accept stringified arrays but it's not recommended." :thumbsup:

support-bot: Ticket created -> RED-8231 (err: clearer validation for rerank). Assigned to carlos_dev.

john_oncall: quick workaround for customers: run `jq -c '.payload.items |= (fromjson? // .payload.items)'` on the body before sending, or fix client serialization.

carlos_dev: I'll add a unit test to the validation layer and include a helpful error code (invalid_items_type) so SDKs can special-case it. ETA: 2 days.

priya_support: replied to customer with repro + workaround. marking as escalated -> pending eng fix. :white_check_mark:
